ORIGINAL SOURCE

Choose the release and adapter profile

Dependency choices come from the selected original archive. Review the exact versions before preparing a runtime.

Adapter selection

Optional adapters in this release

Choose an archive to load its declarations.

Exact version overrides

Exact original pins remain exact. Supported ranges keep their declared baseline unless a compatible explicit pin is selected.

Prepare the reviewed profile

Preparation keeps the original archive and source intact. Upgrade creates a new runtime and preserves the previous directory.

Import another original archive

Or select an existing archive on the operator machine:

The original installer verifies and prepares a source catalog. Native dependencies are selected in the profile above.

RETAINED WORK

Installation and recovery operations

0

Operations run in separate local workers. Closing this browser or restarting its server preserves the original installation and its progress.

Selected log


  

  

    
EXISTING DEPLOYMENT CONTROLS
Hand off a ready runtime

    
Export the original source and dependency roots for the existing merchant host, container or SF46 release workflow. Its existing selection and rollback controls choose the running release.

    
    
Adopt into the existing managed home
Run this command with the current Starforge installation command. Set --home to the managed merchant home outside this runtime directory. The first adoption becomes active; later adoptions are staged for the existing activation and rollback controls.
Complete handoff

    
Keep the selected directory identity
Use sourceRoot and dependencyRoot together. An installed source at DIRECTORY/package/source resolves dependencies from DIRECTORY/node_modules.
The existing SF46 workflow can attach the ready runtime at its actual path. If preparing directly inside a future release directory, choose its final path before preparation. The existing host and release controls own activation, shutdown and rollback.
